title: Seikai Risshiden: Yoi Kuni, Yoi Seiji
native_title: 政界立志伝 ～よい国・よい政治～
overview:
Change Japan's tomorrow yourself!

The first political-world simulation, turning real politics into a board game, is born!

Seikai Risshiden is a sugoroku-style party board game about climbing the ladder of Japanese politics, with the goal of becoming Prime Minister. Start by choosing the career you had before politics, then roll the dice to move around a town map, landing on events that win or lose you support. Bow before the voters, accept or turn down shady offers, and watch out for scandals - one lucky turnaround can save a failing campaign. When a player reaches a set point on the board, election day arrives and the votes are counted.

- 1 to 4 players, with 6Player multitap support
- Memory backup save

日本の明日は自分で変える！

リアルな政治をボードゲームにした初の政界シミュレーション誕生！
